name: Toki o Kanaderu Waltz
source:
This is the sequel to Debonosu’s dragon-raising RPG Sora o Aogite Kumo Takaku. A few years later, Adonis and a young Mint set out on a journey. Along the way, they met the missing dragon girl Thuya and were relieved to see her again. She had not been able to find a partner and made a contract with Adonis to accompany them on their journey. One day, they came upon an old dragon who knelt in front of Thuya and said he had been looking for her. He brought them to the beautiful water city of Alfheim where the princess and Thuya’s twin sister, Salene, wanted to pass on the throne to Thuya. However, Thuya doesn’t remember anything from her childhood and declined the position. Not giving up, Salene decided to join them in the hopes of helping her older sister regain her memories.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/07/01/july-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是Debonosu龙养成RPG《仰望天空，云高处》的续作。数年后，阿多尼斯与年幼的敏特踏上旅程。途中，他们遇见失踪的龙族女孩图雅，重逢令他们松了一口气。图雅始终找不到搭档，便与阿多尼斯缔结契约，同行旅行。某天，他们遇见一头老龙；它跪在图雅面前，说一直在找她。老龙把他们带到美丽的水都阿尔夫海姆，公主、也是图雅双胞胎妹妹的莎琳希望把王位传给图雅。然而，图雅不记得童年任何事，拒绝了这一位置。莎琳没有放弃，决定加入旅程，希望帮助姐姐找回记忆。

[摘自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/07/01/july-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
